_meta.notes: COVER vs CHUNK FILE: candidate, office (County Council District 6), date and period all match the form - the cover's Office box reads 'Council 6' and the separate Office Sought box also reads 'Council 6'. The chunk file's flag was only the listing label 'November'; the form itself checks 'Seven days before a general election', which is consistent. The amendment question has NEITHER 'Yes' nor 'No' ticked - is_amendment left '' (blank), never guessed. Received stamp NOV 01 2016. SUMMARY LINE 1 COLUMN B is the one field I could not settle: it prints '39,3?6.62' where the fourth digit is written over the fifth. At 1200 dpi the glyph has a top bar and a bare diagonal with no closed loop, which matches this filer's 7 (compare line 5 '37,975.69') and not his 9 (compare the '9' in '39,'), so it is recorded as 39,376.62 at LOW confidence - and no arithmetic gate exists for it anywhere in the document (Column B is an aggregate over prior filings not in this chunk). Treat it as unresolved rather than as a read. SCHEDULE ORDER is the normal one (A then B). p3's Page box reads '1 of 1'; p4/p5/p6 read '1 of 3', '2 of 3', '3 of 3'. PRIVACY: the Complete Mailing Address column on p3 is covered by one black bar spanning all five filled rows - donor_city/donor_state blank with 'redacted at source' on every row. Candidate phone/fax/email on the cover are county-redacted and were not read. IN-KIND: the county Schedule A here has no in-kind column and the filer wrote no in-kind marker anywhere, so in_kind is false on every row on the evidence of the page.

contributions.detail: 5 rows sum 8725.00 = the Schedule A printed grand total (8,725.00) = Summary Page line 1 Column A (8,725 with superscript 00). No in-kind marker on the page, so schedule total and Summary figure share one scope. The p3 SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE cell is printed but LEFT BLANK by the filer, so the page-subtotal gate was unavailable on this side; the schedule grand total served instead.

expenditures.detail: The 31 transcribed rows sum 18,308.37 against BOTH printed anchors (Schedule B grand total 18,139.37 and Summary line 2 Column A 18,139.37), a delta of +169.00. The cause is localised to ONE page and is the FILER's arithmetic, not a misread: p5 rows sum 7,489.21 = its printed subtotal EXACTLY, p6 rows sum 1,453.54 = its printed subtotal EXACTLY, but p4's 14 rows sum 9,365.62 against a printed subtotal of 9,196.62. Every one of p4's 14 amounts was re-read in 600 dpi tight crops and each read identically to the first full-page read; no row is doubtful and no row equals 169.00, so the discrepancy sits inside the filer's own addition on that page. The printed subtotals 9,196.62 + 7,489.21 + 1,453.54 do reproduce the printed grand total 18,139.37 exactly, so the filer's error propagates cleanly from his page-1 subtotal into the grand total and into Summary line 2. Both figures retained verbatim; nothing nudged. NOT the schedule-total-vs-summary-gap class - the schedule total and the Summary figure agree here.
